purpose: Prove that the Petpooja staging save_order endpoint acks every payload without validating or persisting, which is why no orderID is ever returned and the dashboard Order List stays empty.
observation: The response is byte-identical for every request. clientOrderID is never echoed even though it is unique per request, and restID is never echoed for either identifier spelling.

catalogCapturedFromMenuPush.source: Petpooja menu PUSH payload delivered to our /petpooja/menu-sync endpoint
catalogCapturedFromMenuPush.significance: Three of the five scenarios Petpooja asked for cannot be produced against this outlet as configured: Addons+Tax needs at least one item with addons (all 166 have itemallowaddon=0 and addongroups is empty); Discount+Tax needs at least one discount (discounts is empty); Addon and Variation+Tax needs both, and additionally no variation definitions were shared despite 81 items having itemallowvariation=1.
